_meta.purpose: Step 1 task routing: agent -> ordered MODEL_REGISTRY key chains. Read by task_routing_resolver (pure, stdlib-only); consumed by LLMGateway.get_agent_chain.
_meta.precedence: OPENROUTER_AGENT_CHAIN_<AGENT> env override > task_routing.json > AGENT_CHAINS > task fallback (CHAINS).
_meta.key_space: MODEL_REGISTRY KEYS ONLY (snake_case ids). Vendor/model-id strings (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5') are REJECTED by the resolver. The gateway maps keys to model-id values.
_meta.fail_mode: Fail-closed per entry: any invalid/unknown key in an agent's list resolves that agent to None (falls through to AGENT_CHAINS). No partial amputation. Missing/corrupt file resolves ALL agents to None.
_meta.restatement_vs_delta: This file is a DELTA over AGENT_CHAINS, not a restatement: only agents whose chain differs from (or is absent in) AGENT_CHAINS are listed. Agents not listed here keep matrix/task behavior byte-identical.
